svg.aria-label: Audit-first: Each skill inspects what is already there and applies only the missing move. A second run is a no-op. Seams carry across the chain: The router shares the queryClient with loaders, guards, forms and realtime. One OpenTelemetry pipeline ships every service's telemetry to one collector. Profile, not assumptions: Every skill reads .claude/stack-profile.md first, so the author's defaults (pnpm, Biome, tests in tests/) stay defaults. Full diagram: The full diagram and the composition chains are in REFERENCE.md
